summary: Backend-only verification of the FCM-independent job-ring SSE fix. All 6 pytest cases pass against the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: partner OTP auth, SSE /realtime/stream 'ready' + keepalive frame model, immediate test-self ring emitting an SSE job_request with booking_id/service_name/city/total/partner_amount, delayed=3 ring firing ~3s later with scheduled:true response, /notifications/devices + /notifications/ring-status stamping the device and appearing in /admin/notifications/health recent_ring_events with user attached, and admin health returning recent_ring_events / recent_delivery_logs / devices without 500.
